from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmissionStats(BaseModel):
    """Admission statistics for first-year students from one document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="When the data is from, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")
    applicants: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking students who applied")
    enrollees: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking students who enrolled")
    cohort_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of student cohort, e.g., 'first-time, first-year degree-seeking'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_admission_stats: list[UniversityAdmissionStats]
